summary: Iteration 277: tested system caller rotation + systemCallerPicks logging, SIP 'calls from' caller-id API + UI (main + extra logins), Infobip SMS DLR webhook (bad key / UNDELIVERABLE refund / idempotency / DELIVERED), Travel eSIM zone codes + flags, admin signup insights, regressions (home/numbers/travel/admin, no console errors). All requested features work. Only minor issues found.

minor.issue: getTrialCaller() runs BEFORE target validation, so a rejected request (e.g. to='12' → 400 invalid_number) still inserts a systemCallerPicks doc and advances the rotation. Verified: invalid request logged '+18648308599 chat=5000000000000901 to=12'. Move the pick after parseTargets/E164/dialIssue checks (or after the trial claim).
Same: pick is logged before showAs validation; invalid showAs → 400 but a landing_test_call pick is logged.

Pick logged when the user merely opens the trial flow (before entering a target); abandoned flows pollute systemCallerPicks and the bot shows a caller ID that may not be the one actually used if another pick happens in between? (callerId saved in state, so OK) — logging-only concern.
trialStatus.callerId always returns SYSTEM_CALLERS()[0] (+18648308599) while the actual trial call may use +16479457172 — UI can show the wrong caller ID.

Unknown loginId returns 200 {ok:true} with no change (should be 404). PUT validation doesn't check capabilities.voice !== false while GET options do — an SMS-only number of the owner can be set via API.

Code review: via() is fine (alt must be same owner + status active). Note a login on a SUSPENDED number with sipCallerId pointing to an active number still resolves (pre-existing suspended match) and will call/bill via the other number — confirm this is intended.

ui_bugs.issue: Username row is blank for +13341112222 (API sipUsername null on this seed number); show '—' or a 'Generate credentials' hint instead of empty value. Likely seed-data, pre-existing.

issues: 'Main SIP login' card title is smaller/plainer (font-semibold, no icon) than sibling cards' headings (SIP credentials, Extra SIP logins) — visually inconsistent
Funnel bar for 0 value ('Signed up (tracked visits)' = 0) still renders a small filled stub; funnel is non-monotonic (Added money 10% > Signed up 0%) which may confuse even with the new label

action_items: Move getTrialCaller() calls after input validation in outbound.js buildCall and trycall.js call-me (and ideally bot trial: after target entered) so systemCallerPicks only records real picks
Make trialStatus callerId reflect the actual caller (or say 'one of our numbers')
PUT /sip/caller-id: 404 for unknown loginId; apply same voice-capability filter as GET
critical_code_review_comments: Rotation counter `rot` is in-process memory; multiple node instances will each alternate independently (fine for preview, note for prod).

DLR route maps REJECTED/UNDELIVERABLE/EXPIRED → delivery_failed → 'failed' + refund; PENDING groups ignored — correct. Idempotent via status $in ['sent','unconfirmed'] filter + deterministic smsref-<id> _id.
Infobip buyNumber skips voice forwarding only when capabilities array exists without VOICE — OK.
